say:2:1330807001:1.text: Lord Ludovic said teapots are used to make tea.
say:2:1330807001:1.source_cn: 不不不，子爵大人说过，茶壶是用来泡茶的。
say:2:1330807001:1.male: Lord Ludovic said teapots are used to make tea.
say:2:1330807001:1.female: Lord Ludovic said teapots are used to make tea.

say:3:1330807002:1.text: I should only be used for my intended purposes. It's a matter of dignity for noble families.
say:3:1330807002:1.source_cn: 作为一名合格的侍者，我们应该专物专用，这是贵族家庭的体面。
say:3:1330807002:1.male: I should only be used for my intended purposes. It's a matter of dignity for noble families.
say:3:1330807002:1.female: I should only be used for my intended purposes. It's a matter of dignity for noble families.

say:5:1330807004:1.text: Oh, it's you who wants tea.

say:6:1330807005:1.text: *Cough* Although this is somewhat improper, I don't mind pouring you a cup of tea...
say:6:1330807005:1.source_cn: 咳，虽然这有些失礼，但给你倒一杯茶也没有什么问题……
